ns0:problem.ns0:para: Katherine is a private chef. The equation C=6.5m+42 models the relation between her weekly cost, C, in dollars and the number of meals, m, that she serves.
ⓐ Find Katherine’s cost for a week when she serves no meals. ⓑ Find the cost for a week when she serves 14 meals. ⓒ Interpret the slope and C-intercept of the equation. ⓓ Graph the equation.
